description: This Java class defines a REST controller for email operations such as listing inbox, sent, drafts, trash, archived emails, fetching email details, searching, composing, saving drafts, and updating email flags. It handles HTTP requests related to email management in a web application.

classes.name: EmailController
classes.description: REST controller managing email-related endpoints such as listing, retrieving, searching, composing, drafting, and updating email flags.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the provided authentication object.

methods.name: inbox
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of inbox emails for the current user.

methods.name: sent
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of sent emails for the current user.

methods.name: drafts
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of draft emails for the current user.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of trash emails for the current user.

methods.name: archived
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of archived emails for the current user.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific email owned by the current user.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a full-text search across subject and body for the current user.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Composes and sends an email, storing a sent copy and internal copies.

methods.name: draft
methods.description: Saves a draft email for the current user.

methods.name: updateFlags
methods.description: Updates read, star, archive, or delete flags for a specific email.
